body_text:
A Laurent series about $z_0$ is
$\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty}a_n(z-z_0)^n$. If $f$ is holomorphic
on an annulus $r<|z-z_0|<R$, it has a unique Laurent expansion
converging on that annulus. The negative powers constitute the
principal part.
